regionSource.comments: Mid forecast based on Goldman Sachs base case (122 GW by 2030, 17% CAGR 2025-2028). High forecast based on S&P Global (134.4 GW by 2030). 2025e baseline of 30 GW from Goldman Sachs/McKinsey consensus. Intermediate years are interpolated from endpoint targets and reported annual additions (~18-31 GW/year). Capacity definition is mixed across sources (facility power, grid demand) and flagged with ?. Sources are public summaries, not raw data.
